Stun is an On Hit Effect status which can also be applied by some Skills.

- 1 Description

- 2 Known Modifiers

- 2.1 Character Stats

- 2.2 Status

- 3 Affixes

## Description[]

Stun prevents an enemy from moving or using skills for 0.4 seconds.

Stun Chance is affected by Stun Avoidance, the formula for which is:

After you have been stunned, you are immune to stuns for 1 second afterwards.

## Known Modifiers[]

### Character Stats[]

- Stun Avoidance - Reduces stun chance

### Status[]

- Time Rot - Increases duration of stuns

## Affixes[]

Affixes can be added to Equipment to increase the stun chance when hitting enemies.
